UpstreamProbeBatch.description: Probe hosts that a diagnostics.upstream.probe.v2 grant covers, each through the domain the app chooses from the listing. The SDK checks that each host appears once. The platform admits every probe with monitoring-class capacity separate from interactive Domain Checks, against a budget of this installation sized for 1,000 hosts probed every 60 seconds.

hostId.description: Host ID from the proxy host listing.

domain.description: One of the listed domains of the host, sent to the upstream like a request for that domain. Wildcard domains cannot be probed.

probeRevision.description: Equals the probeRevision of the host in the listing when the probe ran. A different value means that something the probe observes changed since the host was listed.

httpStatus.description: Status of the upstream response, or null without one. Compare it with the expected status only when failure is null. Built-in monitoring accepts exactly the expected status, and any 2xx or 3xx status while the expected status is the default 200.

anyOf.description: The first stage that prevented a usable upstream response, checked in this order: the active proxy configuration did not serve the host and domain, upstream TLS verification failed, or the upstream sent no HTTP response. Built-in monitoring reports configuration failures as unknown, tls_failed and the upstream codes upstream_unreachable, upstream_timeout and upstream_dns_failed as unhealthy, and any other upstream code as an invalid response.

outcome.description: The probe did not run or its result was discarded. scopeDenied: the grant no longer covers the host. hostRemoved, hostDisabled and domainNotFound: list the hosts again. configurationChanged: the host or proxy configuration changed during the probe; discard it. busy: monitoring-class capacity is in use or a probe of the same host is running. rateLimited: this installation exhausted its probe budget. unavailable: the proxy runtime cannot run probes. Retry busy, rateLimited and unavailable later with backoff.

UiBridgeMessage.description: Check the transfer count and ports outside payload validation. Require the active session port and matching install ID, installation generation, and channel generation for session messages. Close replaced session ports and revoke both ports when the document or installation binding expires. Protected resource actions require the current installation generation and authorization through the authenticated gateway.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem with a stable machine code and no private error details. The type URN suffix equals code; on HTTP the status also equals the status line.

Operation.description: Accepted work has a durable operation ID. Cancellation is an operation request. A disconnect or timeout does not confirm cancellation or rollback.

x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.requests: Versioned requests and closed package, approval, credential and bridge records reject unknown fields. Omitted optional fields are absent. Null is valid only where explicitly declared.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.responses: Readers tolerate additional fields only in open response schemas. Unknown discriminants, required capabilities and security-relevant values are rejected.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.encoding: Protocol member names use camelCase. IDs, revisions and cursors are strings. Timestamps use UTC with milliseconds. Numbers stay within the safe JSON integer magnitude, including in app payloads and open fields. Decoders must reject duplicate members and invalid Unicode. The JSON depth limit counts nested arrays and objects.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.evolution: Within v1 preserve required fields, units, defaults and semantics. Add new optional response fields only to open shapes. Breaking wire changes require a new major version and negotiation before use.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.admission: Check payload bounds and authenticated identity before dispatch. Recheck current installation generation, user delegation, capability and resource scope at the platform boundary. Bound concurrent requests per installation.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.optionalMarketplace: Use separate bounded background requests and keep enrichment outside trusted catalog and installation decisions. Cache or omit enrichment if unavailable. Respect the advertised request size, page and deadline limits.
